pages.title: Alchemical Sourcelink
pages.description: Generates source by  consuming potions  from adjacent potion  jars. The amount of  source varies per  potion and is  dependent on the  complexity of the  potion. Bonus source  is given for the  length and level of  the potion with  multipliers for each  effect a potion
contains. Utilizing  Wixies and Potion  Melders is  recommended for  creating highly  complex potions.
